ttl.name: Front Lower Ball Joint Assembly LH

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Lower Ball Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Lower Ball Joint Turning Condition Inspection

s3.ptxt: Install the nut to the stud of the front lower ball joint assembly LH.
Move the stud back and forth 5 times, then turn it continuously at a rate of 3 to 5 seconds per turn, and measure the turning torque on the 5th turn.

specitem.ptxt: No abnormal catching or play during rotation

s3.ptxt: Check that the dust boot has no cracks or grease leaks.
